title: Quantization variance investigation and calibration runbook for customer-requested model profile
creator: Leah Park
description: Customer X (financial analytics) requested an exception to serve model 'fin-ner-3b' using an INT8 profile to meet latency/cost targets. After initial deployment to a staging Dedicated pool we observed a nontrivial accuracy regression on canonical NER benchmarks used by the customer. This ticket scopes an investigative calibration run, documents a repeatable runbook for ad-hoc exceptions, and proposes an operational guardrail for future exception requests.
acceptance_criteria: Reproduce customer-reported regression on our evaluation harness with the same dataset slice
Produce calibrated INT8 profile variants (symmetric, per-channel, and clipping) and compare to FP8 baseline on precision/recall and end-to-end CI tests
Publish a runbook with exact commands, config snippets, and decision thresholds for approving a customer INT8 exception
Provide a signed-off mitigation plan (rollback/fallback model or automatic fallback to FP8) and monitoring dashboard to detect regressions in production
steps_taken: 01/03: Pulled the customer's redacted evaluation set (10k utterances, finance-NER) into protected staging S3
01/04: Instrumented eval harness to produce token-level F1, slot-level precision/recall, and per-entity confusion matrices
01/05: Ran FP8 baseline (runtime-1.19 profile) to establish reference metrics

01/06-01/09: Ran INT8 variants: symmetric-per-tensor, per-channel, and per-channel with activation clipping (clip=0.01/0.02/0.05); each run recorded latency, peak memory, and seed-stochasticity traces
01/10: Re-ran highest variance cases with five random seeds to estimate flip-rate and metric variance
01/11: Compared outputs with token-level diff tool and generated a candidate rollback plan
results_summary: Baseline FP8 F1=0.923. Initial INT8 symmetric produced F1=0.881 (delta -4.6%). INT8 per-channel improved to F1=0.912 (delta -1.2%). Per-channel + clip=0.02 reduced delta to -0.2% (F1=0.921) while meeting latency targets (median token latency reduced by 18%). Seed variance on problematic samples showed 0.3-0.9% metric noise; majority of regression concentrated in low-frequency entity types. No memory or OOM errors observed in Dedicated staging pool.
decision: Provisional approval for a scoped customer exception using INT8 per-channel with activation clipping (clip=0.02) and bias-correction, gated behind: 1) a per-customer regression monitor with alert threshold set at delta F1 > 0.5%, 2) a canary rollout limited to 5% of requests and automatic rollback to FP8 on breach, and 3) a 30-day post-deploy evaluation report. Long-term: automate this calibration flow into Optimize to reduce manual effort.
next_steps: Document CLI commands and config snippet for the approved INT8 profile under Confluence (runbook page)
Create a small release PR to runtime-1.20 with the INT8 profile JSON and unit tests (PR draft created)
Add production monitor to Console: per-customer F1/latency dashboard + alert playbook
Coordinate with Support and Customer Success to schedule the canary and communicate rollback criteria
Plan an automation ticket to integrate this calibration run into the Optimize recommendations pipeline (follow-up ENG task)
Schedule a post-canary sync with customer and provide evaluation artifact bundle
